column8: ["The machine reads as a delicate arrangement of pale buttons rather than a weighty kiln-floor object, with little distinctive character in its painted surfaces.","The brown metal looks uniformly muddy rather than rubbed brass, and the cream seats lack convincing glaze and contact-edge wear.","Across the circular seats, dark upper crescents and bright lower rims create directional lighting that would swing when the sprite rotates.","The pale, domed-looking seat centres read as filled caps rather than clearly empty receiving seats."]
